features: ZTNA (Zero Trust Network Access): Operates on a "never trust, always verify" principle. It grants access to specific applications rather than the entire network based on continuous identity and device posture verification.

CASB (Cloud Access Security Broker): Secures and monitors interactions between users and cloud-based applications (SaaS/IaaS), enforcing security policies and data protection across services like Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and Salesforce.
FWaaS (Firewall-as-a-Service): Provides cloud-native, next-generation firewall protection, inspecting all traffic without needing physical hardware at each office or branch location.
